title: The Power of the Cross
lyrics_original: O, to see the dawn of the darkest day
Christ on the road to Calvary
Tried by sinful men, torn and beaten, then
Nailed to a cross of wood.
This the power of the cross:
Christ became sin for us.
Took the blame, bore the wrath;
We stand forgiven at the cross.
O, to see the pain written on Your face,
Bearing the awesome weight of sin.
Every bitter thought, every evil deed
Crowning the bloodstained brow.
This the power of the cross:
Christ became sin for us.
Took the blame, bore the wrath;
We stand forgiven at the cross.
Now the daylight flees; now the ground beneath
Quakes as the Maker bows His head.
Curtain torn in two, dead are raised to life.
"Finished!" the victory cry.
This the power of the cross:
Christ became sin for us.
Took the blame, bore the wrath;
We stand forgiven at the cross.
O, to see my name written in the wounds,
For through Your suffering I am free.
Death is crushed to death, life is mine to live,
Won through Your selfless love!
This the power of the cross:
Son of God slain for us.
What a love! What a cost!
We stand forgiven at the cross.

bible_verses.english: But he was wounded for our transgressions. He was bruised for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his stripes we are healed.
For him who knew nothing about sin he made to be sin on our behalf; so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

You, being dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh, he made alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses, having blotted out the bond written in ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us: and he has taken it out of the way by nailing it to the cross;

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for bearing the heavy weight of my sin upon the cross. I am deeply humbled that You took my blame and endured such pain so that I could know Your unconditional love. Today, I stand forgiven, redeemed, and secure in Your endless grace. Help me to live each moment in awe of the love You poured out for me at Calvary. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: The Power of the Cross invites us to gaze upon the breathtaking love of Jesus as He carried the unbearable weight of our sin to Calvary. In the darkest moments of history, Christ willingly traded His purity for our brokenness, taking our blame so we could stand completely forgiven. As we sing these words, let your heart rest in the quiet wonder of His sacrifice. May His unmerited grace fill you with deep gratitude and give you peace today.
